# `unbounded-loop`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: disciplined · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a `while` loop with no visible comparison bound, exhaustion condition,
or counter guard.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An unstated bound turns corrupted input or a missing event into a hang with no
declared worst case.

## When it fires

Iterator and reader exhaustion, sentinel traversal, queue drains (including
`while (stack.items.len != 0)`), scans to an `.eof` token, blocking waits,
event-loop dispatch, and retry-on-interruption loops are exempt. A retry loop
is one whose only way to repeat is an interrupted or would-block system call: a
`switch` prong for `.INTR` or `.AGAIN` (or one calling `checkCancel`), or an
`if` testing for those values, while every other prong or branch returns or
breaks. An empty loop repeating a fallible step is exempt too, since each step
reports whether it made progress: `while (try ops[0].toLea(cg)) {}`. Like the
other disciplined-profile rules it skips `test` blocks, private functions only
tests call, and test, fuzz, and script files.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn spin(flag: *bool) void {
    while (true) {
        flag.* = !flag.*;
    }
}
```
